summary: One-frame request to play the 'carried' prepare animation of a character that is being picked up to be thrown (attached to the thrower's hand). Written by bg3.exe+0x1A2BB60 (attaches the carried entity to the thrower's visual, creates ecl::thrown::DummyAttachmentComponent) only when the carried entity is a character; read by ecl::animation::GameplaySystem (macOS query). Never seen alive. Registry total 2 (client row).
